cases.root_cause: Official libpng advisory: after failed/incomplete zTXt/iTXt/iCCP decompression, a released zstream can retain nonzero avail_in and next_in into chunk-buffer or stack storage. If the application calls png_read_info then png_read_end without starting row reads, IDAT refill is skipped and inflation can read the stale pointer. Fix aa77ef38c17ab2fc1b41bec09fb973c6a386641d adds png_inflate_detach_buffers and clears zstream input/output pointers and counters on acquisition and release.

The fix walks the parent chain iteratively.

cases.root_cause: Flowbuffer parsing trusts header-derived entry lengths and indexes. FlowbufStrAtIndex sums lengths into offset, reads current strLen and returns dataSegment+offset without proving offset+strLen stays within MAX_FLOWBUF_DATA_SIZE. ProcessNativeProxyResultNewFlowbuf writes dataList[curIndex] in three loops without curIndex < dataListSize, where dataList is sized from argsSize + flowbufSize. Official fix adds a mapped-data range rejection and dynamic-vector index guards.
